text:
William Jewell College picks Academic Search for presidential search
William Jewell College has selected Academic Search to lead a national search for its next president.
William Jewell College announced Monday, Oct. 26, that it has selected Academic Search to partner with the college in conducting a national search for its next president, according to the college.
The announcement came in a letter to the college community from Tyler Griffin, vice chair of the Board of Trustees and chair of the Presidential Search Committee. The college said Academic Search was chosen following a competitive review of search firms and interviews with finalists, with the committee weighing each firm's experience, approach to community engagement, ability to recruit strong candidates, and understanding of Jewell's mission and character.
According to the college, Academic Search was founded in 1976 and has worked exclusively with higher education institutions, conducting more than 900 presidential searches. The search will be led by Dr. Pamela Balch, a senior consultant with Academic Search who the college said brings more than 30 years of experience in higher education, including 13 years as a college president.
The college said that in November, Academic Search will gather input from faculty, staff, students, alumni, trustees and other members of the Jewell community, and that Dr. Balch will visit campus to meet with key constituent groups as part of that effort. That feedback is intended to help shape a presidential profile reflecting the college's priorities, opportunities and aspirations for its next leader, the college said.
Following the Search Committee's approval of the profile, the college said it anticipates launching the national search in early December. The college said its goal is to appoint the next president in spring 2027, with the new president assuming office on July 1, 2027. The college also said it is establishing a dedicated Presidential Search section on its website to serve as a central resource for information about the process.
Source: William Jewell College, https://jewell.edu/william-jewell-college-announces-presidential-search-partner/
